title: Water Damage Mitigation Labor Rate Sheet
content:
Water Damage Mitigation technician and supervisor labor is billed by the hour at the business-hours rate of the job's tier; labor in the after-hours or holiday window carries the tier's after-hours labor multiplier.

| Tier | Technician per hour | Supervisor per hour | After-hours labor multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $78.50 | $96.40 | 1.5 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $74.60 | $91.60 | 1.5 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $78.50 | $96.40 | 1.5 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $74.60 | $91.60 | 1.5 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $84.25 | $102.80 | 1.5 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $80.05 | $97.65 | 1.5 |

## Definitions
- **Technician rate**: Water mitigation technician labor per hour, business-hours rate, USD.
- **Supervisor rate**: Mitigation supervisor labor per hour, business-hours rate, USD.
- **After-hours labor multiplier**: Multiplier on hourly labor rates for labor performed in the after-hours or holiday window, decimal.

## Hypothetical illustration
With an assumed business-hours rate of $60.00 per hour (an illustrative figure, not a tier rate) and the multiplier of 1.5 that every tier carries, an hour worked in the after-hours window is billed at $90.00, the business-hours rate multiplied by 1.5.
